remarks: A sophisticated blend of past & present, this private sanctuary offers the ultimate in modern design in the heart of Westport. Designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living, the property features 5 BRs, 4.5 BAs, a separate guest house, expansive decking & a gunite pool set on private 1.35 acres. The home retains its massive original central chimney now the striking centerpiece of the open main level. The rooms flow seamlessly to the exterior gardens, while expansive walls of glass create a natural connection to the outdoors throughout the seasons. The spectacular 14' limestone kitchen island anchors the space alongside a limestone accent wall & a dramatic portrait window overlooking the patio, dining pavilion & pool. Each impeccably curated room showcases a refined juxtaposition of old & new, creating a cohesive, timeless aesthetic. The luxurious primary suite includes a stunning marble bath, dressing room & scenic views of the grounds. The finished walk-out lower level offers space for yoga, fitness, recreation, plus a walk-in natural stone wine cellar & pool changing room. Tiered steps lead to the pool terrace, ideal for lounging amid magnificent specimen trees and lush gardens. A separate guest house mirrors the organic warmth & texture of the main residence. Mature landscaping screens the fully fenced private level property in a prime Westport location within walking distance to Wakeman Farm, minutes to the train, beaches, shops, restaurants, schools, and other amenities.
